agent.finish_summary: Fixed IndexError regression in sqlparse/filters/reindent.py `_process_case`: changed `first = next(cond[1].flatten())` to `first = next(cond[0].flatten())`. The `cond` tuple from `Case.get_cases()` is (condition_tokens, value_tokens); for the initial pre-WHEN entry, value_tokens is empty, causing `cond[1].flatten()` to raise IndexError. Using cond[0] (the condition tokens, which include the CASE keyword/leading tokens) matches the intended logic and how cond[0]/cond[1] are used elsewhere in the same function and in aligned_indent.py. Verified reindent formatting of CASE statements (simple CASE, searched CASE with expression, CASE without ELSE) and reindent+compact mode all work correctly now, with existing non-CASE reindent behavior unaffected.
